name: zenzic-css-toolchain
description: Pins the Tailwind CLI that builds docs/assets/css/zenzic-tailwind.min.css. Not a runtime dependency of Zenzic: the Python package ships no JavaScript, and CI installs nothing from here. The build stays a human-operated step (see docs/assets/css/README.md); this file exists so that step is reproducible instead of resolving to whatever version is current on the day it is run.
